name: hotfix_2026_11_25_part4
objective: Full notes: official Blizzard hotfix post, linked in the description.
pages: Its proc chance now rolls once per wave of an area spell, not once for every target hit.
No longer lasts for the whole duration of channeled spells.
Gnomes, Humans, Night Elves and Dwarves can no longer go to war with the Kirin Tor.
Dwarves can no longer go to war with the Wildhammer Clan.
These class mount quests now also teach Journeyman Riding:
Justice and Retribution (Forsaken Paladins), Judgment and Redemption (Dwarf and Human Paladins).
Talk to these NPCs for a free Journeyman Riding option.
Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in Stormwind Cathedral.
Zevrost at the Cleft of Shadow, Orgrimmar.
Ursula Deline at the Slaughtered Lamb, Stormwind.
The Explosive Runeshard no longer hugely boosts the Felguard Sentinel's Mortal Strike.
Hunter: Saving the Best for Last
The Horde version can now be completed.
Encrypted Twilight Texts drop again for Secret Communication, True Believers and Still Believing.
The repeatable Cenarion Circle turn-in is off on purpose. Still Believing can still send you a recipe by mail later.
The Dark Iron have recruited more Steamsmiths for Smithing Tuyere and Lookout's Spyglass.
The Scarlet Illusion now lasts 1 hour instead of 30 minutes.
